title: Building Git infrastructure for agent-scale development
author: Brian Celenza
description: We're rebuilding GitHub's Git infrastructure while GitHub keeps running, creating a foundation for agent-scale software development. The post Building Git infrastructure for agent-scale development appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Every day on GitHub, millions of developers build the products their customers rely on, contribute to open source, and pursue personal projects. GitHub’s architecture has changed steadily over the years to support that work and the growing demands of the developers and organizations who depend on it.
takeaways: With developers and agents working concurrently in repositories that receive millions of commits a day, these workloads demand a different Git architecture.
We’re investing deeply in Git infrastructure to meet the demands of agentic software development and give teams a foundation built for their most ambitious workloads.
